title: Spectral Design of Random-Duration Switchbacks
summary: A switchback experiment alternates an entire system between treatment and control over time. It is especially useful when interactions between units can undermine standard unit-level experiments. Switchback experiments are commonly implemented on fixed temporal grids, which impose highly structured restrictions on when treatment can switch. We study a broader class of random-duration switchbacks, in which treatment and control alternate across runs whose durations are drawn from a common distribution.
